name: SmartMemory Capture
description: Save web pages, articles, selections and screenshots to your own library, and sync them to SmartMemory.

content_security_policy.extension_pages: script-src 'self'; object-src 'none'; img-src 'self' data: blob: https: http:; connect-src 'self' https: http://localhost:* http://127.0.0.1:*; frame-src 'none';
